It opens a s"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"earchable panel for the subagents currently discovered by the DSH client runtime."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Current release: **v1.9.1** — full history in `CHANGELOG.md` (English) and `CHANGELOG.zh.md` (中文)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install in the Web profile"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Install the published package from npm into your DSH Web profile:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Upgrade to the latest published version:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Uninstall:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`dsh plugin --profile <name> <args…>` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside that profile, so the usu"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"al `add` / `update` / `remove` subcommands apply. No `--allow-build` flag is needed: the published t"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"arball already ships a prebuilt `lib/`, and the package declares no install-time lifecycle scripts."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The bundle includes `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the manager and shadows exactly one stock slot"},{"id":"p14s2","text":": `conversation.session.header.lineage` is claimed by a `priority: -1` title-only shadow so DSH's st"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ock `ui-subagent` lineage dropdown stays invisible while this package is installed. The stock `ui-su"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"bagent` plugin itself is **left enabled** — this package no longer disables it wholesale, because th"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"e sidebar tab it provides is the navigation target of the new "open in the sidebar" button. The shad"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ow renders the session title instead of an empty entry, so the subagent session header keeps its tit"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"le. Removing the package removes this bundle layer, and the host's `ui-subagent` setting is untouche"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"d, so your own configuration is restored as it was. Restart the existing `dsh web` process, then ref"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"resh `http://127.0.0.1:3080` after the plugin is available."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If you previously disabled `ui-subagent` manually in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, you "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"can keep that stanza: it is user-owned and intentionally preserved. The plugin no longer needs (or w"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"rites) such a stanza."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Working on a checkout instead of the npm release? See Local checkout (contributors)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Scope: entry, workspace and session"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Compact title-bar trigger shows the active-child count and animated activity dot without opening t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"he panel.
- Defaults to the main session's current workspace and current session, even when the user"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" is viewing a child session.
- Workspace and session selectors support current workspace, all worksp"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"aces, named workspaces, current session, and named sessions.
- Show session IDs beside names, compac"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"t metadata, token totals, and creation time in the relative-time tooltip.
- Ordinary search matches "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"names, titles and workspace names; the `id:` prefix searches Session IDs only (`id: graph:g-a92e1406"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"es, titles and workspace names; the `id:` prefix searches Session IDs only (`id: graph:g-a92e1406`)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Search, sorting and grouping"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Sort by recent activity, name, or type; recently running children remain near the top after they f"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"inish.
- Group by session, workspace, category, type, or no grouping. Session headers show the works"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"pace and parent session name."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Categories"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Browser-local classification tabs support custom regular expressions. Those hosts span two "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"API tiers — 0.1.5-rc.3 and 0.1.6-alpha.2 still publish `subagentsByParent`, `refreshSubagents` and `"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"setSubagentCatalogOpen`, while 0.1.7-rc.1 **removed** `sessions.setSubagentCatalogOpen`, **renamed**"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" `refreshSubagents(parentSessionId)` to `refreshProjections(sessionId)`, and **replaced** `SessionLi"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"stState.subagentsByParent` with the parent session's own `subagentCatalog` projection. Every call si"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"te probes for the capability it needs, so both generations work and no version number is ever compar"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"probes for the capability it needs, so both generations work and no version number is ever compared."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**0.2.0-rc.1** was checked the same way — package by package against **0.1.7-rc.1** (23 host package"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s plus the CLI, app boot and the web frontend), not against its release notes — and it needs **no ad"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"aptation** either: no host face this plugin reads changed structurally. The two slot declarations it"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" registers, the module-loader shell and its seeded `require` keys, the `subagentCatalog` / `subagent"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"` / `subagentTiming` projections (including the generational `lastTurnCompleted` field), `subagentAd"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"dress` / `openResource` / `candidates`, the `dsh plugin --profile web add` flow and all 21 `--dsw-*`"},{"id":"p26s7","text":" tokens this plugin uses are unchanged or purely additive; the only contract addition is an optional"},{"id":"p26s8","text":" `fork(onCreated)` the plugin never calls, and the stock web graph dropping its `ui-schedule` row do"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"es not touch this plugin or its slot shadow. Two differences are visible but not breaking: one dark-"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"theme token the panel and the floating card use for their glass surface changed value, and the sideb"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"ar services appear **even later** than on 0.1.7-rc.1 (see “Open in the sidebar” below)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Session navigation (three capability tiers)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`uiWorkspace` is read through `ctx.get('uiWorkspace')`, never through a required injection, so hosts"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" that do not register the service (everything before **0.1.2-alpha.5**) still load and keep using th"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"e session-controller path, while hosts that removed `openSubagent`/`open` (**0.1.6-alpha.2**) use th"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"e workspace service. **The probe order follows the argument shape, not the version**: `sessions.open"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"Subagent` accepts an address object on every host that has it, whereas `uiWorkspace.openSession` onl"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"y accepts a `SessionTarget` from **0.1.6-alpha.2** on — on **0.1.5-alpha.2 … 0.1.6-alpha.1** it is `"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"openSession(sessionId)` and routes through `sessions.open(id)`, which throws on an address. The sess"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"ion-controller tier is therefore tried first and the workspace service is the fallback. Within the c"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"ontroller tier the exact `{ parentSessionId, childSessionId, mode }` address is used first and only "},{"id":"p30s10","text":"a missing mode/child falls back to plain session navigation, because `openSubagent` rejects addresse"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"s that are not healthy catalog children.
